description: The agent must: (1) Read the input file at company/hr/relocation/incoming_hires_q1_2025.json to understand the three employee profiles. (2) Read the Miami SKILL.md and its referenced auxiliary files (tech.md, startup.md, student.md, cost.md, neighborhoods-choosing.md, transport.md) from skills/miami/. (3) For Sarah Chen (Senior SWE): recommend Wynwood/Brickell/Design District per the tech worker neighborhood rule — NOT South Beach; debunk her assumption that she won't need a car; include the correct car insurance range ($200-400/month, Florida highest in US); include the correct salary range ($120K-180K, no state income tax). (4) For Marcus Webb (Startup CTO): recommend Wynwood as primary startup hub; debunk the 'Miami is a cheap alternative to NYC' myth (rent now comparable, salaries lower); include the post-Surfside condo assessment warning. (5) For Priya Nair (grad intern): use the correct student budget range ($1,800-2,500/month); debunk her assumption that public transit is adequate (Miami is NOT like Boston, a car is needed). The agent must actively ignore the misleading data in drafts/outdated/miami_2020_draft.md and company/hr/relocation/miami_notes_UNVERIFIED.txt.
